Base forms mwaqafle/mwaqəf are provisional regularised citation forms inferred from mwaqafleli and mwaqfatle; only the source inflections are used as examples.
Active agent/patient alternations include mwaqfili, mwaqəfallox, mwaqəfxulli and mwaqafleli. The machine English “you have been detained” does not establish a Detransitive paradigm.
The reader’s “negated” description of Darḥal mwaqfili is incorrect: it is a positive immediate detention event.

Naḏara, ḥabis, ṣawǧi and ḥakəm delimit custodial detention. The single lexical sense covers it; the data do not establish a general stopping sense, an administrative suspension sense or a light-verb collocation.
